title: Calcineurin Inhibitor CN585 Exhibits Off-Target Effects in the Human Fungal Pathogen Aspergillus fumigatus.
authors: Juvvadi, Praveen R; Bobay, Benjamin G; Cole, D Christopher; Awwa, Monaf; Steinbach, William J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型钙调磷酸酶抑制剂CN585对烟曲霉的脱靶抗真菌作用，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Calcineurin (CN) is an attractive antifungal target as it is critical for growth, stress response, drug resistance, and virulence in fungal pathogens. The immunosuppressive drugs, tacrolimus (FK506) and cyclosporin A (CsA), are fungistatic and specifically inhibit CN through binding to their respective immunophilins, FK506-binding protein (FKBP12), and cyclophilin (CypA). We are focused on CN structure-based approaches for the development of non-immunosuppressive FK506 analogs as antifungal therapeutics. Here, we examined the effect of the novel CN inhibitor, CN585, on the growth of the human pathogen Aspergillus fumigatus, the most common cause of invasive aspergillosis. Unexpectedly, in contrast to FK506, CN585 exhibited off-target effect on A. fumigatus wild-type and the azole- and echinocandin-resistant strains. Unlike with FK506 and CsA, the A. fumigatus CN, FKBP12, CypA mutants (DeltacnaA, Deltafkbp12, DeltacypA) and various FK506-resistant mutants were all sensitive to CN585. Furthermore, in contrast to FK506 the cytosolic to nuclear translocation of the CN-dependent transcription factor (CrzA-GFP) was not inhibited by CN585. Molecular docking of CN585 onto human and A. fumigatus CN complexes revealed differential potential binding sites between human CN versus A. fumigatus CN. Our results indicate CN585 may be a non-specific inhibitor of CN with a yet undefined antifungal mechanism of activity.
abstract_zh: 钙调磷酸酶（CN）是真菌病原体中生长、应激反应、药物耐药性和毒力所必需的关键因子，因此是一个有吸引力的抗真菌靶点。免疫抑制药物他克莫司（FK506）和环孢素A（CsA）具有抑真菌作用，并通过与其各自的亲免素——FK506结合蛋白（FKBP12）和亲环蛋白（CypA）结合，特异性抑制CN。我们专注于基于CN结构的策略，以开发非免疫抑制性FK506类似物作为抗真菌治疗药物。在此，我们研究了新型CN抑制剂CN585对人类病原体烟曲霉（Aspergillus fumigatus）生长的影响，该病原体是侵袭性曲霉病最常见的病因。出乎意料的是，与FK506相比，CN585对烟曲霉野生型以及唑类和棘白菌素耐药菌株表现出脱靶效应。与FK506和CsA不同，烟曲霉CN、FKBP12、CypA突变体（DeltacnaA、Deltafkbp12、DeltacypA）及多种FK506耐药突变体均对CN585敏感。此外，与FK506相反，CN585未抑制CN依赖性转录因子（CrzA-GFP）从胞质到核的转位。将CN585与人源和烟曲霉CN复合物进行分子对接，揭示了人源CN与烟曲霉CN之间潜在的差异结合位点。我们的结果表明，CN585可能是一种非特异性CN抑制剂，其抗真菌作用机制尚未明确。
